title: All build jobs stuck NOT_RUNNING after v2.4.1 deploy — schema migration type mismatch
description: Deploy of jobs-svc v2.4.1 at 14:19Z introduced V88 schema migration that changed job_type column from text to integer. Strict schema validation in JobDistributor failed on mixed-type rows written during rollout. 4,200 jobs stuck NOT_RUNNING for 16 minutes. Fixed by deploying bridge code v2.4.2 that accepts both column types. Source: based on CircleCI incident 2021-11-08.

title: Add schema migration smoke test and rollback validation to deploy pipeline
description: Add pre-deploy validation that runs migration and reads/writes with new schema before shifting traffic. Require explicit forward/backward compatibility proof for type changes. Add queue-depth alert that fires within 60s of jobs stuck NOT_RUNNING.
